products.title: Dusk till Dawn: Two Player Starter Set
products.body_html:
This Two Player Starter Set contains everything you need to start playing Moonstone, the game crowned as both Best Miniatures Range and Best Miniatures Rules by the judges at UK Games Expo 2023!

Two Player Starter Set

Contains:

  • 4 Human Miniatures made in fine quality resin with bases and stat cards:
    • Baron von Fancyhat, Eric the Squire, Flintlock and Friar Flavius  (Starter set exclusive!)
  • 4 Goblin Miniatures made in fine quality resin with bases and stat cards:
    • Doug the Flatulent, Beaky Bobby, Vicious Syd and Grub (Starter set exclusive!)
  • 1 x Moonstone Card Deck (18 Melee Cards, 21 Arcane Cards and 2 Quick reference cards)
  • 1 x Rules Pamphlet
  • 49 x Blue Energy Counters
  • 1 x Moonstone Measuring Widget
  • 7 x 4 Sided Dice
  • 2 x 6 Sided Dice

Miniatures are multipart and require assembly.
